description: Generating, checking, making and taking back moves. Moves are matched by from-square, to-square and promotion piece; the other flags are filled in by the board.

functions.name: legal_moves

returns.description: Complete moves with all flags; the order is not part of the API.

functions.description: All legal moves, in one call (R7). Empty if the side to move is checkmated or stalemated.

functions.name: legal_captures
functions.description: The legal moves with is_capture, including en passant and capturing promotions.

functions.name: is_legal

returns.description: False for NULL_MOVE, RESIGN and every malformed value.

functions.description: Whether a legal move with the same from-square, to-square and promotion piece exists.

functions.name: parse_move

returns.description: The complete move with all flags.

functions.description: Reads UCI notation and looks the move up in this position.

functions.name: make_move
functions.description: Plays a legal move and appends it to the history. On error the board is unchanged.

functions.name: undo_move
functions.description: Takes back the last move. InvalidState if the history is empty or the last entry is a null move.

functions.name: make_null_move
functions.description: Passes the turn to the other side for null-move pruning; clears the en passant square and increases the halfmove clock. InvalidState while in check.

functions.name: undo_null_move
functions.description: Takes back the last null move. InvalidState if the last entry of the history is not a null move.
